<function name="SetAmmoType" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>Changes the ammo type used by the weapon that inflicted the damage.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ammoType" type="number">Ammo type ID</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates a new DamageInfo object and sets the ammo that caused the damage to AR2 ammo</description>
	<code>
local dmginfo = DamageInfo()

dmginfo:SetAmmoType( game.GetAmmoID( 'AR2' ) )
	</code>

</example>
